Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class GlBringUpPlanner

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.GlBringUpPlanner
public final class GlBringUpPlanner extends Object
The pure decision layer for bringing Java 3D up on the target GL stack (Phase F). On the LFS/bare-Xorg host the compositor must confirm that Jogamp obtains a hardware GLX context with DRI3 on the real GPU DDX, and that lg3d's own Canvas3D window is exempted from Composite redirection (else the physical screen is black). Those two facts are probed live; this class turns the probe results into a single verdict plus the operator-facing remediation, with no gnu.x11.Display, no GL context and no reflection, so the bring-up decision is unit-testable headlessly.

It codifies the acceptance criteria in docs/lfs-x11-contract.md §5 (GLX/DRI3 hardware rendering) and the lg3d.x11.ownwindowid fallback documented on X11Compositor.exemptOwnWindow().

  • Method Details

    • plan

      public static GlBringUpPlanner.Verdict plan(GlBringUpPlanner.Probe probe)
      Decides the bring-up verdict. Precedence: no GLX aborts; an unresolved own window id must be pinned (a hard display blocker even when GL is fine); otherwise a hardware stack is GlBringUpPlanner.Verdict.READY and a software one is GlBringUpPlanner.Verdict.SOFTWARE_ONLY.
      Parameters:
      probe - the probe results (null is treated as no GLX)
      Returns:
      the verdict; never null

    • remediation

      public static String remediation(GlBringUpPlanner.Verdict verdict)
      The operator-facing remediation for a verdict (empty for GlBringUpPlanner.Verdict.READY).
      Parameters:
      verdict - the verdict to explain
      Returns:
      a one-line remediation string; never null

    • resolveOwnWindowId

      public static long resolveOwnWindowId(String override, long discoveredId)
      Resolves lg3d's own X window id from an optional override string and a reflectively-discovered id — the pure decision behind X11Compositor.exemptOwnWindow(). The override (decimal or 0x hex) wins when it parses to a positive id; otherwise the discovered id is used.
      Parameters:
      override - the lg3d.x11.ownwindowid property value (may be null/blank/invalid)
      discoveredId - the id discovered from the AWT peer, or <= 0
      Returns:
      the resolved id, or -1 when neither yields a positive id
